items.text: Woowe, singa omutwe gwange gubadde mugga
kubanga bakola ekibi kino ate ne bongera ekirala;
na buli wamukwano agenda awaayiriza buwaayiriza.
ne beemalamu amaanyi nga bakola ebitali bya butuukirivu.
kiki ate kye nnaakolera abantu bange
buli muntu ayogeza mirembe n'akamwa ke,
naye mu mutima gwe ategeka kumutega.
era ne nkungubagira amalundiro ag'omu ddungu.
Mugezigezi ki anaayinza okutegeera kino? Ani oyo
gw'abuulidde alyoke akinnyonnyole? Lwaki ensi eyonoonese ng'eddungu ne wataba agiyitamu?
n'agamba nti, "Kubanga balese amateeka gange, ge nabateekerawo. Tebaŋŋondedde wadde okugoberera amateeka gange.
Naye, bagoberedde obukakanyavu bw'emitima gyabwe ne basinza ebifaananyi bya Babaali nga bajjajjaabwe bwe baabayigiriza."
ow'Eggye, Katonda wa Isirayiri nti, "Laba ndiriisa abantu bano emmere ekaawa ne mbanyweesa n'amazzi ag'obutwa.
Ndibasaasaanya mu mawanga bakitaabwe ge bataamanya; era ndibasindiikiriza n'ekitala, okutuusa nga mbazikirizza."
okutuusa amaaso gaffe lwe ganaakulukuta amaziga,
Kubanga amaloboozi ag'okukungubaga gawuliddwa mu Sayuuni;
Kaakano mmwe abakazi, muwulirize ekigambo kya Katonda,
era mutege okutu kwammwe kuwulire ekigambo ky'akamwa ke.
era buli muntu ayigirize munne okukungubaga.
"Omusajja omugezi aleme kwenyumiririza mu magezi ge,
oba omusajja ow'amaanyi okwenyumiririza mu maanyi ge
Naye leka oyo eyeenyumiriza yeenyumirizenga mu kino:
, "lwe ndibonereza abo bonna abakomole obukomozi mu mubiri:

Misiri, ne Yuda, ne Edomu, n'abaana ba Amoni, ne Mowaabu, era n'abo bonna ababeera mu ddungu mu bifo eby'ewala. Kubanga amawanga gano gonna ddala si makomole, ate era n'ennyumba ya Isirayiri yonna si nkomole mu mutima."
